definition: To explain something in more detail; or, very detailed and complicated.
exampleSentences: Could you elaborate on your answer about the water cycle?
The artist created an elaborate painting with hundreds of tiny details.
tip: When you elaborate, you LABOR to add more details!

definition: A result or effect of an action or condition.
exampleSentences: One consequence of not studying is getting a low grade.
The report discussed the consequences of pollution on wildlife.
tip: Every action has a CONSEQUENCE that follows!

definition: To convince someone to do or believe something.
exampleSentences: She tried to persuade her parents to get a puppy.
The speaker persuaded the audience to recycle more.
tip: Great speakers know how to PERSUADE people with words!

definition: To examine or study something carefully to find out the truth.
exampleSentences: The detective investigated the mystery of the missing necklace.
Scientists investigate how plants grow in different soils.
tip: InVESTigate — put on your detective VEST and look for clues!

definition: Important enough to have an effect or be noticed.
exampleSentences: The invention of the internet was a significant event in history.
There was a significant improvement in her test scores.
tip: If it's SIGNIFICANT, it SIGNIFIES something big!

definition: To give something (time, money, ideas) to help achieve something.
exampleSentences: Everyone can contribute to making the world a better place.
She contributed her ideas to the group project.
tip: When you CONTRIBUTE, you TRIBUTE (give) something valuable!

definition: To examine something in detail to understand it better.
exampleSentences: The students analyzed the poem to find its hidden meaning.
Scientists analyze data to draw conclusions.
tip: When you ANALYZE, you break things apart to understand them!

definition: A feeling of deep sympathy and concern for others who are suffering.
exampleSentences: She showed compassion by helping the new student feel welcome.
Leaders with compassion make the world a better place.
tip: COM-PASSION — sharing your PASSION for caring with others!

definition: In addition to what has already been said; also.
exampleSentences: The park is beautiful. Furthermore, it has a playground for children.
The project was completed on time. Furthermore, it was under budget.
tip: Use FURTHERMORE to add FURTHER points to your argument!

definition: Able to recover quickly from difficulties; tough and flexible.
exampleSentences: The resilient plant grew back after the harsh winter.
Resilient people bounce back from setbacks stronger than before.
tip: Like a rubber band, resilient things bounce back!
